title: Krishna Sahasranamam
intro: Krishna Sahasranamam is the sacred hymn of the 1000 names of Lord Krishna. Chanting it deepens devotion, inner peace, and divine love.
description:
Dhyanam & Sankalpa (Invocation)
Om Asya Shri Krishna Sahasranama Stotra Mantrasya Garga Rishiḥ |
Anushtup Chhandaḥ | Shri Krishno Devata |
Kleem Beejam | Swaha Shaktiḥ | Shri Gopala Krishna Preetyarthe Jape Viniyogaḥ ||
(Sage Garga is the seer of this 1000-name hymn; Anushtup is the meter; Shri Krishna is the Deity; 'Kleem' is the seed sound; 'Swaha' is the power; recited to please Lord Gopala Krishna.)

Verses 1–10
1. Krishnaḥ Vishnu Jishnurdevo Vasudevo Sanatanaḥ |
Gopalo Gopatirgopeepatirgovardhanodhdaraḥ ||1||
(The All-Attractive, All-Pervading, Victorious Lord, Son of Vasudeva, Eternal One, Protector of Cows, Master of Cows, Lord of the Gopis, Lifter of Govardhan Mountain.)

2. Navaneetaharo Balo Yashodanandavardhanaḥ |
Devakeenandanaḥ Shreeman Rohineepriya Nandanaḥ ||2||
(Butter Thief, Divine Child, Increaser of Yashoda's Joy, Son of Devaki, Glorious One, Beloved Son of Rohini.)

3. Kamsarirdhenukarishcha Bakarih Pootanatakaḥ |
Trinavartaharo Daityariḥ Keshishakatamardanaḥ ||3||
(Enemy of Kamsa, Slayer of Dhenuka, Enemy of Baka, Destroyer of Putana, Vanquisher of Trinavarta, Enemy of Demons, Crusher of Keshi and Shakatasura.)

4. Kaleeyadamano Dhiro Ramo Balabhadranujaḥ |
Vamsheedharo Venupanirmuralidhara Eva Cha ||4||
(Subduer of Kaliya, Courageous One, Balarama's Younger Brother, Flute Holder, Flute in Hand, Player of the Murali Flute.)

5. Peetambaradharo Devo Vanamali Gadadharaḥ |
Shreevatsakaustubhaddharo Radhikahridayalayaḥ ||5||
(Wearer of Yellow Garments, Lord Wreathed in Wildflowers, Wielder of the Mace, Bearer of Shrivatsa mark and Kaustubha gem, Dweller in Radha's Heart.)

6. Vrindavanacharo Nityam Rasamandalamandanaḥ |
Vrindapatiḥ Kalpavriksho Nikunjagrihanayakaḥ ||6||
(Eternal Wanderer of Vrindavan, Ornament of the Rasa Dance circle, Lord of Vrinda/Tulsi, Wish-Fulfilling Tree, Lord of the Bower Cottages.)

7. Shreemadhusudano Dantaḥ Chanuramardano Bali |
Kuvalayapeedahanta Cha Kamsapranaharo Hariḥ ||7||
(Slayer of Madhu demon, Self-Controlled, Crusher of Chanura, Mighty One, Slayer of Kuvalayapida elephant, Taker of Kamsa's Life, Remover of Sins.)

8. Ugrasenapratishtata Vasudevavimochakaḥ |
Satyabhamapatiḥ Kanto Rukmineeramano Prabhuḥ ||8||
(Restorer of King Ugrasena, Deliverer of Vasudeva, Husband of Satyabhama, Beloved Lord of Rukmini.)

9. Jambavatipatiḥ Shreeman Satyajaniranakulaḥ |
Kalindipatiravyagro Mitravindapriyamvadaḥ ||9||
(Husband of Jambavati, Glorious Spouse of Satya, Calm Lord of Kalindi/Yamuna, Sweet-Spoken Lover of Mitravinda.)

10. Lakshmanavallabho Devo Bhadrapatiroudaradhiḥ |
Shodashastreesahasresho Narakasuraghatakaḥ ||10||
(Beloved of Lakshmana, Generous Husband of Bhadra, Lord of 16,000 Queens, Slayer of Narakasura.)

Verses 11–20
11. Murarirmadano Mohanashchakrapanirjanardanaḥ |
Parijatapaharta Cha Banabahavikhandanaḥ ||11||
(Enemy of Mura, Enchanter like Cupid, Holder of the Chakra/Discus, Refuge of Humanity, Stealer of the Parijata Tree, Severer of Bana's Arms.)

12. Shishupalashirachhetta Dantavaktravinashanaḥ |
Poundrakapranahari Cha Satyakipriyakridvaraḥ ||12||
(Beheader of Shishupala, Destroyer of Dantavakra, Taker of Paundraka's Life, Dearest Well-Wisher of Satyaki.)

13. Draupadeemanarakshashcha Pandavanam Hitaishinaḥ |
Kuruvanshavinashi Cha Pandavapriyakarakah ||13||
(Protector of Draupadi's Honor, Well-Wisher of the Pandavas, Destroyer of the Kuru Lineage, Doer of Good for the Pandavas.)

14. Parthasarathiravyagro Geetamritamahodadhiḥ |
Vishvasvaroopadhrik Devo Bhishmamokshapradayakaḥ ||14||
(Charioteer of Arjuna, Ocean of Nectar of the Bhagavad Gita, Manifestor of the Cosmic Form, Bestower of Liberation to Bhishma.)

15. Viduranandadayi Cha Kunteesankatanashanaḥ |
Dharmarajapratishtata Sarvashastravisharadaḥ ||15||
(Giver of Joy to Vidura, Reliever of Kunti's Distress, Restorer of Yudhishthira, Master of All Scriptures.)

16. Akroorapriyakrichhooraḥ Sudamabhagyavardhanaḥ |
Uddhavajnanadata Cha Sandipanigurupriyaḥ ||16||
(Heroic Friend of Akrura, Increaser of Sudama's Fortune, Bestower of Knowledge upon Uddhava, Beloved Pupil of Guru Sandipani.)

17. Paramatma Param Brahma Jagannatho Jagadguruḥ |
Sarvajnaḥ Sarvado Devaḥ Sarveshaḥ Sarvatomukhaḥ ||17||
(Supreme Soul, Absolute Truth, Lord of the Universe, Universal Teacher, All-Knowing, Giver of All, Lord of All, Facing All Directions.)

18. Anadiriha Sarvesho Vishvakarma Visharadaḥ |
Achintyo Aprameyatma Nirguno Gunasagaraḥ ||18||
(Beginningless Lord of All, Cosmic Creator, Masterful One, Incomprehensible, Immeasurable Soul, Attribute-less yet Ocean of Divine Qualities.)

19. Niranjano Nirakaro Bhaktavatsala Ishvaraḥ |
Satyavrataḥ Satyasandhaḥ Satyadharmaparayanaḥ ||19||
(Taintless One, Formless Absolute, Loving to Devotees, Supreme Lord, True to Vows, Truthful in Promise, Devoted to Eternal Righteousness.)

20. Avyakto Vyaktagambheeraḥ Sarvavyapee Nirantaraḥ |
Omkararoopee Bhagavan Vishvatma Vishvabhavanaḥ ||20||
(Unmanifest yet Profound in Manifestation, All-Pervading, Continuous, Embodiment of Omkara, Soul and Creator of the Universe.)

Verses 21–30
21. Narayano Narasreshto Jishnurjishnupriyaḥ Suhrit |
Srashta Dhata Vidhata Cha Samharta Prabhavo Bhavaḥ ||21||
(Refuge of Man, Foremost of Beings, Victorious, Dearest Friend of Arjuna, Creator, Sustainer, Ordainer, Destroyer, Source of Existence.)

22. Kalo Mahakalamurteerudro Rudrapriyankaraḥ |
Shivaḥ Sarvo Mahadevo Brahma Brahmavidamvaraḥ ||22||
(Time, Form of Cosmic Time, Rudra/Shiva, Pleaser of Shiva, Auspicious One, All-in-All, Supreme Deva, Brahma, Foremost Knower of Brahman.)

23. Yagnesho Yagnabhokta Cha Yagno Yagnanga Eva Cha |
Yagnavahanadevesho Yagnaraksakaro Mahan ||23||
(Lord of Sacrifice, Enjoyer of Sacrifice, The Sacrifice Itself, Limbs of Sacrifice, Lord of Sacrifice Bearers, Great Protector of Sacrifices.)

24. Chaturbhujaschaturmurtischaturvyuhaschaturgatiḥ |
Sahasramurdha Vishvatma Sahasrakshaḥ Sahasrapat ||24||
(Four-Armed, Four-Fold Form, Four Emanations, Ultimate Four-fold Goal, Thousand-Headed, Cosmic Soul, Thousand-Eyed, Thousand-Footed.)

25. Amriteshaḥ Suredreshaḥ Sarvadevamayaḥ Prabhuḥ |
Lakshmipatirjagaddhata Vaikuntho Garudadhvajaḥ ||25||
(Lord of Nectar, Lord of Indra, Comprising All Deities, Master, Consort of Lakshmi, Sustainer of Earth, Dweller in Vaikuntha, One with Garuda Emblem.)

26. Padmanabho Hrishikeshaḥ Keshavo Madhusudanaḥ |
Madhavaḥ Pundareekaksho Vamano Balisudanaḥ ||26||
(Lotus-Navel Lord, Master of Senses, Slayer of Keshi, Destroyer of Madhu, Lord of Knowledge, Lotus-Eyed, Vamana, Subduer of Bali.)

27. Trivikramo Jagadvandyo Nrisimho Daityadaranaḥ |
Varaho Prithividhari Matsyaḥ Kurmo Jagatpatiḥ ||27||
(Lorder of Three Worlds, Worshiped by All, Man-Lion Incarnation, Tearer of Demons, Boar Avatar, Holder of Earth, Fish Avatar, Tortoise Avatar, Lord of the Universe.)

28. Dashavatararoopeshaḥ Sarvashaktidharo Vibhuḥ |
Kamadevaḥ Kamapalaḥ Kamakshikamayakaḥ ||28||
(Lord of Ten Avatars, Bearer of All Powers, All-Pervading, God of Love, Fulfiller of Desires, Bestower of Wishes.)

29. Mahamayo Mahaveeryo Mahabalasamanvitaḥ |
Mahabuddhirmahateja Mahadyutidharaḥ Sudheeḥ ||29||
(Master of Great Illusion, Of Supreme Valor, Endowed with Great Strength, Of Vast Intellect, Of Supreme Splendor, Wise and Radiant.)

30. Mahamano Mahayogi Mahakraturudaradhiḥ |
Amoghaḥ Siddhasankalpaḥ Siddheshaḥ Siddhadayakaḥ ||30||
(Of Great Mind, Supreme Yogi, Great Sacrifice, Broad-Minded, Unfailing One, Whose Will is Ever Accomplished, Lord of Siddhis, Bestower of Perfection.)

Verses 31–40
31. Pavitram Pavanam Nityam Mangalyam Mangalaspadam |
Sarvapapaharam Devam Bhaktimuktipradayakam ||31||
(Purest One, Purifier, Eternal, Auspiciousness Itself, Abode of Blessings, Destroyer of All Sins, Bestower of Devotion and Liberation.)

32. Anadinidhano Devo Golokadhamanayakaḥ |
Radhamanoharo Nityam Radhahridayavallabhaḥ ||32||
(Without Beginning or End, Lord of Goloka Abode, Constant Stealer of Radha's Mind, Beloved of Radha's Heart.)

33. Radhikaprananathashcha Radharamanadevata |
Lalitavishakhasevyo Gopeevrindavritaḥ Prabhuḥ ||33||
(Lord of Radhika's Life Breath, Divine Lover of Radha, Served by Lalita and Vishakha, Surrounded by Hosts of Gopis.)

34. Yamunateeracharee Cha Kadambamulasamsthitaḥ |
Tribhangi Lalitakaro Muraliravamohana||34||
(Wanderer on Yamuna's Banks, Seated at the Root of the Kadamba Tree, Three-Fold Bending Graceful Form, Enchanter with Flute Notes.)

35. Barhipinchhavatamsashcha Mayurapinchhabhooshanaḥ |
Natavaravapuḥ Shreeman Venuvadyavisharadaḥ ||35||
(Adorned with Peacock Feather Crown, Decorated with Peacock Plumes, Form of the Supreme Dancer, Master of Flute Playing.)

36. Rasasakto Rasikesho Rasarajo Rasottamaḥ |
Anandakando Govindo Gopaveshadharo Hariḥ ||36||
(Absorbed in Rasa, Lord of Aesthetics, King of Divine Taste, Supreme Flavor, Root of Joy, Govinda, Disguised as a Cowherd.)

37. Vatsasuraharo Veeraḥ Bakasuravinashanaḥ |
Aghasurasamharta Cha Dhenukarimahabalaḥ ||37||
(Slayer of Vatsasura, Hero, Destroyer of Bakasura, Vanquisher of Aghasura, Mighty Enemy of Dhenuka.)

38. Pralambarirbalabhadro Mushtikaghno Mahamatiḥ |
Mallamushtikasamharta Rangavisphorano Vibhuḥ ||38||
(Enemy of Pralamba, Powerful Brother Balarama, Slayer of Mushtika, Highly Intelligent, Crusher of Wrestlers, Illuminator of the Arena.)

39. Kamsamurdhabhishiktashcha Ugrasenasukhapradaḥ |
Pitrimatrivimokta Cha Gurusevaparayanaḥ ||39||
(Slayer/Crown-Shatterer of Kamsa, Giver of Happiness to Ugrasena, Liberator of Parents, Devoted Servant of the Guru.)

40. Avadhootapriyo Nityam Sudamapremavardhanaḥ |
Kubjalepanasantushto Kubjaroopapradayakaḥ ||40||
(Beloved of Ascetics, Nurturer of Sudama's Love, Pleased with Kubja's Ointment, Restorer of Kubja's Beauty.)

Verses 41–50
41. Dvarakadurganeta Cha Samudramadhyashramaḥ |
Ratnasanugrihadheesho Manikootanivasakrit ||41||
(Leader of Dwarka Fortress, Resident in the Midst of the Ocean, Master of Jewel-Pillared Palaces, Dweller on Ruby Peaks.)

42. Ashtadashaksharimantro Mantrarajo Mahamanuḥ |
Gayatri Mantraroopee Cha Sarvavedamayo Vibhuḥ ||42||
(Eighteen-Syllable Mantra, King of Mantras, Great Incantation, Form of the Gayatri Mantra, Embodiment of All Vedas.)

43. Rigvedo Samavedo Cha Yajurvedastathaiva Cha |
Atharvavedaroopee Cha Vedanga Sarvashastravit ||43||
(Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharvaveda Form, Limbs of the Vedas, Knower of All Scriptures.)

44. Itihasapuraneshaḥ Sankhyayogavisharadaḥ |
Dharmashastraprayokta Cha Dharmarajanishevitaḥ ||44||
(Lord of Histories and Puranas, Expert in Sankhya and Yoga, Teacher of Duty/Ethics, Served by Yudhishthira.)

45. Kalidoshaharo Nityam Kalimalmashanashanaḥ |
Yugavataraḥ Sarvesho Kalachakrapravartakaḥ ||45||
(Remover of Kali-Age Flaws, Destroyer of Sins of Kali Yuga, Avatar of the Era, Lord of All, Turner of the Wheel of Time.)

46. Satyayugaprade Neta Tretradvaparakalpakaḥ |
Kalkisangramahanta Cha Dushtagrahadinashanaḥ ||46||
(Guide to Satya Yuga, Ruler of Treta and Dvapara, Kalki Warrior, Destroyer of Malevolent Planets.)

47. Sarvavignaharo Devo Sarvasiddhipradayakaḥ |
Sarvasampatpradata Cha Sarvashatruvinashanaḥ ||47||
(Remover of All Obstacles, Bestower of All Perfections, Giver of All Wealth, Destroyer of All Enemies.)

48. Sarvajvaraharaḥ Shreeman Sarvarogavinashanaḥ |
Sarvagrahavinashi Cha Sarvada Bhayanashanaḥ ||48||
(Reliever of Fevers, Glorious Destroyer of All Diseases, Annihilator of Evil Planetary Impacts, Forever Destroyer of Fear.)

49. Sarvaduḥkhaharo Nityam Sarvanandapradayakaḥ |
Ayuḥprado Balaprado Yashodha Keertivardhanaḥ ||49||
(Constant Reliever of Sorrows, Bestower of Supreme Joy, Giver of Longevity, Strength, Fame, and Glory.)

50. Putraputraprado Shreeman Dhanadhanyasamriddhidaḥ |
Sarvakamaprado Devo Sarvasaubhagyadayakaḥ ||50||
(Bestower of Children and Grandchildren, Giver of Wealth and Grain, Fulfiller of All Desires, Granter of Good Fortune.)

Verses 51–60
51. Bhaktabhayaprado Nityam Sharanyaḥ Sharanagataḥ |
Deenabandhuḥ Kripasindhurbhaktakalpadrumo Mahan ||51||
(Giver of Fearlessness to Devotees, The Supreme Refuge, Compassionate to Surrendered Souls, Friend of the Poor, Ocean of Mercy, Wish-Fulfilling Tree for Devotees.)

52. Dayaluḥ Karunasindhurartatranaparayanaḥ |
Anathanathaḥ Sarvajno Bhaktakaryarthasadhakaḥ ||52||
(Kind-Hearted, Ocean of Compassion, Savior of the Distressed, Lord of the Destitute, All-Knowing, Accomplisher of Devotees' Goals.)

53. Sarvalokahitaishi Cha Sarvapranahite Rataḥ |
Shantaḥ Dantaḥ Jitakrodho Jitendriyo Mahamuniḥ ||53||
(Well-Wisher of All Worlds, Engaged in the Good of All Living Beings, Peaceful, Self-Controlled, Conqueror of Anger, Master of Senses, Great Sage.)

54. Veetarago Mahatyagi Brahmachari Dridhavrataḥ |
Satyavadi Satyarataḥ Satyapratijna Ishvaraḥ ||54||
(Free from Attachment, Great Renunciate, Celibate, Firm in Vows, Speaker of Truth, Lover of Truth, True to His Promise.)

55. Dayavan Gunavan Jnani Jnanamudradharo Vibhuḥ |
Yogeshaḥ Yogagamyah Cha Yoginamabhayapradaḥ ||55||
(Merciful, Virtuous, Wise, Displaying the Jnana Mudra, All-Pervading, Lord of Yoga, Attainable through Yoga, Giver of Fearlessness to Yogis.)

56. Sachidanandarupeshaḥ Paramanandavigrahaḥ |
Advaitaḥ Sarvabhootatma Nirvikalpo Niranjanaḥ ||56||
(Lord of Truth-Consciousness-Bliss Form, Embodiment of Supreme Joy, Non-Dual One, Soul of All Beings, Changeless, Pure.)

57. Aksharaḥ Paramam Dhama Vyomavyapee Sanatanaḥ |
Sarvaprapancharahito Vishvateeta Ujjvalaḥ ||57||
(Imperishable, Supreme Abode, Pervading Space, Eternal, Free from Material Delusion, Transcending the Universe, Radiant.)

58. Tejomayo Mahamurtiḥ Prakashaḥ Paramam Padam |
Paratparo Gurgamyo Jyotiḥsvaroopa Ishvaraḥ ||58||
(Full of Light, Great Manifestation, Illumination, Highest Realm, Higher than the Highest, Attainable through Guru, Embodiment of Divine Light.)

59. Samagami Surarighnaḥ Sarvalokanamaskritaḥ |
Devarshivanditaḥ Shreemadnaradadimunistulaḥ ||59||
(Singer of Samaveda, Destroyer of Demon-Enemies, Saluted by All Worlds, Revered by Celestial Sages, Incomparable to Sages like Narada.)

60. Sanakadimunidhyeyaḥ Shukavedadipoojitaḥ |
Shivabrahmadigeetashreeḥ Sarvadevaganairvritaḥ ||60||
(Meditated upon by Sanaka and Sages, Worshiped by Shuka and Vedic Seers, Sung by Shiva and Brahma, Surrounded by Host of Devas.)

Verses 61–70
61. Gandharvaganasantushto Apsaradvrundavanditaḥ |
Yaksharajanishevyaścha Kuberadhanadayakaḥ ||61||
(Pleased with Gandharva Music, Honored by Apsaras, Served by King of Yakshas, Giver of Wealth to Kubera.)

62. Indrahuto Mahateja Suryachandranalopamaḥ |
Vayurakasharoopeshaḥ Prithivee Jalameva Cha ||62||
(Invoked by Indra, Of Immense Radiance, Like Sun, Moon, and Fire, Lord in the Forms of Wind, Ether, Earth, and Water.)

63. Ashtamurtidharo Devo Ashtasiddhipradayakaḥ |
Navanidhisamriddhesho Sarvaishvaryapradayakaḥ ||63||
(Manifesting 8 Cosmic Forms, Granter of 8 Yogic Siddhis, Lord of 9 Divine Treasures, Bestower of All Opulence.)

64. Samrajyadaḥ Rajyado Cha Swargado Mokshadaḥ Prabhuḥ |
Sarvalokaprabho Shreeman Sarvamangaladayakaḥ ||64||
(Giver of Empires, Giver of Kingdoms, Giver of Heaven, Giver of Liberation, Master of All Realms, Granter of All Auspiciousness.)

65. Akrooravanditaḥ Shreeman Viduranandadayakaḥ |
Barhishmadmakhakarta Cha Shatatangavinashanaḥ ||65||
(Worshiped by Akrura, Bringer of Joy to Vidura, Performer of Vedic Sacrifices, Destroyer of Hundreds of Afflictions.)

66. Rukmivyuhavihanta Cha Rukmineemanavardhanaḥ |
Pradyumnajanako Shreeman Aniruddhapitamahaḥ ||66||
(Breaker of Rukmi's Phalanx, Increaser of Rukmini's Honor, Father of Pradyumna, Grandfather of Aniruddha.)

67. Sambamukhyatmajo Devo Bahuputrasamanvitaḥ |
Dvarakavaibhavo Nityam Yaduvanshashiromaniḥ ||67||
(Father of Samba and Many Sons, Eternal Glory of Dwarka, Crown Jewel of the Yadu Dynasty.)

68. Yadavendro Yadavesho Yadusreshto Yaduprayaḥ |
Vrishninatho Vrishnipatiḥ Shoorasenakulodbhavaḥ ||68||
(King of Yadavas, Lord of Yadu Clan, Best among Yadus, Beloved of Yadus, Master of Vrishnis, Born in Shurasena's Lineage.)

69. Mathuramandalasvami Gokulapriyadayakaḥ |
Vrajavasi Vrajadheesho Vrajalokabhayapradaḥ ||69||
(Lord of Mathura Region, Bringer of Joy to Gokula, Resident of Vraja, Master of Vraja, Giver of Fearlessness to Vraja Folk.)

70. Gopeegopalasamvrito Dhenuvrindasamavritaḥ |
Venudhvanisamakrishtasarvapranimanoharaḥ ||70||
(Surrounded by Gopis and Cowherd Boys, Encircling Herds of Cows, Enchanter of All Beings Drawn by Flute Sounds.)

Verses 71–80
71. Radhikapranasarvasvo Radhikachittachorakaḥ |
Radhikanetrachakoro Radhikarasamandalaḥ ||71||
(All-in-All of Radhika's Life, Stealer of Radhika's Mind, Chakora-Bird Gazing at Radhika's Eyes, Lord of Rasa with Radhika.)

72. Radhikapremarasiko Radhikanandavardhanaḥ |
Radhikacharanambhojabhrunggo Radhikaya Yutaḥ ||72||
(Connoisseur of Radhika's Love, Enhancer of Radhika's Joy, Bee at the Lotus Feet of Radhika, Ever United with Radhika.)

73. Nityaleelavinodee Cha Nityadhamanivasakrit |
Golokadhamadhishono Rasamandalamadhyagaḥ ||73||
(Enjoyer of Eternal Pastimes, Dweller in Eternal Abode, Sovereign of Goloka, Standing in the Center of the Rasa Circle.)

74. Vrindavanadhidevashcha Yamunajalakeelikrit |
Govardhanagiridhari Girirajapujakaraḥ ||74||
(Presiding Deity of Vrindavan, Sportsman in Yamuna Waters, Lifter of Govardhan Hill, Initiator of Govardhan Worship.)

75. Surabhipratipalashcha Surabhiprarthito Vibhuḥ |
Indradarwaharashchaiva Indrapujavighatakaḥ ||75||
(Protector of Celestial Cows, Implored by Surabhi, Subduer of Indra's Pride, Stopper of Sacrifice to Indra.)

76. Meghagarjanasamharta Vrajameghanivarakaḥ |
Ekangulidharadreeshaḥ Vrajarakshanatatparaḥ ||76||
(Silencer of Thundering Clouds, Shield against Torrential Downpours, Mountain-Lifter on Little Finger, Ever-Protector of Vraja.)

77. Govindo Namasampannaḥ Sarvadevaiḥ Prapoojitaḥ |
Abhishikto Devarajaiḥ Sarvalokamaheshvaraḥ ||77||
(Endowed with the Name Govinda, Worshiped by All Devas, Anointed by King of Gods, Supreme Lord of All Worlds.)

78. Varado Bhaktabhayadaḥ Sharanyaḥ Sharanagatah |
Samsaratarako Devo Bhavasagaratarakah ||78||
(Granter of Boons, Deliverer from Fear, Ultimate Shelter, Rescuer of Surrendered Souls, Deliverer from Worldly Existence, Ferryman across the Ocean of Rebirth.)

79. Paparashidahanashcha Sarvaduḥkhanivarakaḥ |
Sarvakamaprado Nityam Sarvasiddhipradayakaḥ ||79||
(Burner of Heaps of Sins, Dispeller of All Misery, Eternal Fulfiller of Desires, Granter of All Perfections.)

80. Dharmarthakamamokshanam Data Bhuktimuktidaḥ |
Ishtapoortapradata Cha Sarvayagnaphalapradaḥ ||80||
(Giver of Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha; Granter of Enjoyment and Liberation; Giver of Sacrificial Merits, Fruit of All Sacrifices.)

Verses 81–90
81. Ashtangayogahalado Bhaktimargarasapradaḥ |
Premabhaktipradata Cha Sadhunam Hitakarakaḥ ||81||
(Bestower of Results of Eight-Fold Yoga, Granter of Sweetness on Devotional Path, Giver of Pure Loving Devotion, Well-Wisher of the Righteous.)

82. Dushtadaityavinashi Cha Sadhurakshanatatparaḥ |
Dharmasamsthapanakaro Yuge Yuge'vataradhrik ||82||
(Destroyer of Wicked Demons, Dedicated Protector of Saints, Establisher of Righteousness, Incarnating Age after Age.)

83. Shreemadbhagavatavedyo Geetashastrapravartakaḥ |
Mahabharatasootre Cha Sarvavedarthaparagaḥ ||83||
(Known through Shrimad Bhagavatam, Originator of the Bhagavad Gita, Thread of Mahabharata, Expert in Meaning of All Vedas.)

84. Vedantakridvedavichcha Sarvashastravisharadaḥ |
Kaviḥ Puranapurusho Mahayogi Maheshvaraḥ ||84||
(Author of Vedanta, Knower of Vedas, Master of All Sciences, Visionary Poet, Ancient Primeval Being, Supreme Yogi, Great Lord.)

85. Sachidanandavigraho Nityamuktaroopadhrik |
Sarvavyapee Sarvasakshi Sarvalokapitamahaḥ ||85||
(Form of Eternal Truth-Knowledge-Bliss, Eternally Liberated Manifestation, All-Pervading, Universal Witness, Grandfather of All Worlds.)

86. Sarvabhootashayasthito Sarvantaryamyeeshvaraḥ |
Sarveshaḥ Sarvadaḥ Sarvaḥ Sarvamangalamangalam ||86||
(Seated in the Hearts of All Creatures, Inner Controller, Lord of All, Bestower of All, Everything, Auspiciousness of Auspiciousness.)

87. Sarvapapaharam Shreeman Sarvavyadhivinashanam |
Sarvashatrukshayakaram Sarvasiddhipradayakam ||87||
(Remover of Sins, Glorious Vanquisher of Diseases, Destroyer of Adversaries, Granter of Complete Success.)

88. Shri Krishnaḥ Kamalanatho Vasudevo Sanatanaḥ |
Vasudevatmajo Punyo Leelamanushavigrahaḥ ||88||
(Shri Krishna, Lord of Lakshmi, Eternal Vasudeva, Meritorious Son of Vasudeva, Human Form for Divine Pastimes.)

89. Shreevatsakaustubhaddharo Radhikanandavardhanaḥ |
Yashodanandano Devo Devakeenandano Hariḥ ||89||
(Bearer of Shrivatsa and Kaustubha, Increaser of Radhika's Joy, Son of Yashoda, Son of Devaki, Lord Hari.)

90. Gokulanandado Natho Varado Bhaktavatsalaḥ |
Pootanajeevitharo Yashodabhagyavardhanaḥ ||90||
(Giver of Joy to Gokula, Lord, Granter of Boons, Loving to Devotees, Taker of Putana's Life, Increaser of Yashoda's Fortune.)

Verses 91–100
91. Trinavartasurapranahari Vrindavanacharaḥ |
Vatapatrashayee Devaḥ Shakatāsurakhandanaḥ ||91||
(Slayer of Trinavarta, Wanderer of Vrindavan, Child Reclining on Banyan Leaf, Destroyer of Shakatasura.)

92. Kaleeyadamano Dhiro Govardhanadharo Bali |
Gopalo Gopeekanatho Gopeejanamohanaḥ ||92||
(Subduer of Kaliya, Courageous One, Lifter of Govardhan, Mighty Cowherd, Lord of Gopis, Enchanter of Gopis.)

93. Vatsasuravinashtatma Bakasuravinashanaḥ |
Aghasuravinashi Cha Dhenukasuramardanaḥ ||93||
(Annihilator of Vatsasura, Destroyer of Bakasura, Slayer of Aghasura, Crusher of Dhenukasura.)

94. Pralambaghnatmajo Veero Vamsheedhavavisharadaḥ |
Gopanganavrito Nityaḥ Rasaleelavisharadaḥ ||94||
(Heroic Brother of Balarama who slew Pralamba, Master Flutist, Ever Surrounded by Gopis, Master of Rasaleela.)

95. Manahari Daityahari Kanatripuraghatakaḥ |
Radharamanchittatma Radhasampraptavigrahaḥ ||95||
(Stealer of Pride, Destroyer of Demons, Vanquisher of Evil Fortresses, Soul of Radharamana, Reunited with Radha.)

96. Makhanachoro Navaneetanathaḥ Govardhanadharakaḥ |
Maturangagato Balaḥ Kandukakreedanapriyaḥ ||96||
(Butter Thief, Lord of Fresh Butter, Holder of Govardhan, Child in Mother's Lap, Lover of Ball Games.)

97. Kamsadootanivari Cha Kuvalayapeedamardanaḥ |
Chanuramardano Devahitaḥ Kamsavinashanaḥ ||97||
(Repeller of Kamsa's Emissaries, Crusher of Kuvalayapida, Vanquisher of Chanura, Well-Wisher of Gods, Slayer of Kamsa.)

98. Ugrasenapratishtata Vasudevavimochakaḥ |
Sandipaniguroḥ Shishyo Matripitrihitavrataḥ ||98||
(Restorer of Ugrasena, Deliverer of Vasudeva, Disciple of Sandipani, Devoted to Parents' Welfare.)

99. Dvarakanagareerantha Rukmineeramano Prabhuḥ |
Satyabhamapatiḥ Shreeman Jambavatipriyaḥ Sada ||99||
(Lord of Dwarka City, Beloved Husband of Rukmini, Consort of Satyabhama, Ever Dear to Jambavati.)

100. Satyajanirmanitmikravindapatistatha |
Lakshmanaramano Devo Bhadrajaniranakulaḥ ||100||
(Spouse of Satya and Mitravinda, Delighter of Lakshmana, Calm Consort of Bhadra.)

Verses 101–110
101. Narakasurasamharta Murarirgarudadhvajaḥ |
Sahasrashodashastreenampatirmadhusudanaḥ ||101||
(Slayer of Narakasura, Enemy of Mura, Banner of Garuda, Lord of 16,000 Queens, Slayer of Madhu.)

102. Parijatapaharta Cha Banabahavikhandanaḥ |
Shishupalamukhamitrasamharta Chakrahastakaḥ ||102||
(Taker of Parijata Tree, Severer of Bana's Arms, Slayer of Shishupala and Foes, Holder of the Discus.)

103. Dantavaktravinishtatma Poundrakapranaharakaḥ |
Satyakipriyakridvooraḥ Draupadeemanarakshakaḥ ||103||
(Annihilator of Dantavakra, Taker of Paundraka's Life, Dear Friend of Satyaki, Protector of Draupadi's Honor.)

104. Pandavanamhitakari Kuruvanshavinashanaḥ |
Geetamritapradata Cha Arjunakrodhanashanaḥ ||104||
(Benefactor of Pandavas, Destroyer of Kuru Dynasty, Bestower of Bhagavad Gita Nectar, Reliever of Arjuna's Distress.)

105. Vishvaroopadharo Devo Bhishmamokshapradaḥ Prabhuḥ |
Dharmojo Dharmarajestaḥ Punyashloko Janardanaḥ ||105||
(Displayer of Cosmic Form, Bestower of Liberation to Bhishma, Born of Righteousness, Beloved of Yudhishthira, Of Sacred Renown, Helper of Humanity.)

106. Dvividasurasamharta Balabhadrapriyaḥ Sada |
Sambotpaditadaityariḥ Pradyumnakritanandanaḥ ||106||
(Slayer of Dvivida Gorilla, Ever Dear to Balarama, Father of Demon-Destroying Samba, Delighter of Pradyumna.)

107. Aniruddhatmajo Shreeman Ugrasenasukhapradaḥ |
Uddhavasya Guruḥ Shreeman Mahabhagavataḥ Prabhuḥ ||107||
(Grandfather of Aniruddha, Granter of Happiness to Ugrasena, Guru of Uddhava, Supreme Divine Lord.)

108. Akroorapriyakriddhyayo Viprasudamabhaktidaḥ |
Brahmanyo Vedavedango Vedantaparago Muniḥ ||108||
(Object of Akrura's Meditation, Granter of Devotion to Sudama, Friend of Brahmins, Master of Vedas and Vedanta.)

109. Yogeshvaro Yogagamyastyaktasamsarabandhanaḥ |
Yagnasreshto Yagnabhokta Yagnango Yagnavahanaḥ ||109||
(Lord of Yoga, Reached through Yoga, Free from Worldly Bondage, Foremost Sacrifice, Enjoyer of Sacrifices, Sacrificial Embodiment and Vehicle.)

110. Sanatanaḥ Parabrahma Vasudevo Namo'stu Te |
Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya Sarvamangaladayakam ||110||
(Eternal Supreme Brahman, Vasudeva, Salutations to You! Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya, Bestower of All Auspiciousness.)

|| Iti Shri Gargasamhitayam Shri Krishna Sahasranamastotram Sampoornam ||
(Thus ends the Sri Krishna Sahasranama Stotram from the Garga Samhita.)

faq.a1: Krishna Sahasranamam is a sacred hymn containing the 1000 divine names of Lord Krishna. Each name reflects His divine qualities, virtues, and glorious pastimes.
faq.q2: What are the benefits of chanting Krishna Sahasranamam?
faq.a2: Chanting Krishna Sahasranamam is believed to bring devotion, inner peace, divine love, spiritual growth, and the blessings of Lord Krishna.
faq.q3: When should I recite Krishna Sahasranamam?
faq.a3: It can be recited in the morning or evening. Thursdays, Ekadashi, and Krishna Janmashtami are considered especially auspicious.
faq.a4: Yes. Both men and women can chant Krishna Sahasranamam with faith and devotion.
faq.q5: Can I chant Krishna Sahasranamam every day?
faq.a5: Yes. Daily recitation is considered highly auspicious and helps strengthen devotion, peace of mind, and spiritual discipline.
faq.a6: Krishna Sahasranamam is found in Hindu scriptures, including the Mahabharata and various Vaishnava texts and Puranas dedicated to Lord Krishna.
faq.q7: What is the difference between Krishna Sahasranamam and Krishna Ashtottara Shatanamavali?
faq.a7: Krishna Sahasranamam contains the 1000 names of Lord Krishna, while Krishna Ashtottara Shatanamavali contains 108 sacred names.
faq.a8: Yes. Anyone can chant Krishna Sahasranamam with sincere devotion. No special initiation is required.
faq.q9: How many times should I recite Krishna Sahasranamam?
faq.a9: There is no fixed rule. Most devotees recite it once in a sitting, while others chant it according to their devotion.
faq.q10: Which is the best day to chant Krishna Sahasranamam?
faq.a10: Krishna Janmashtami, Ekadashi, and Thursdays are considered the most auspicious occasions to chant Krishna Sahasranamam.
